LESSON: DIMENSIONS OF MORALITY IN ISLAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.1: Dimensions of Morality in Islam
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Dimensions of Morality in Islam, part of Akhlaq (Moral Teachings) in Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why should Muslims have good morals?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research online/from available books on sources of morality i.e. Quran and Sunnah and make notes guided by the teacher,

2. discuss the purpose of morality and make a presentation,

3. role play acts depicting good morals.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research online/from available books on sources of morality i.e. Quran and Sunnah and make notes guided by the teacher,
2. discuss the purpose of morality and make a presentation,
3. role play acts depicting good morals.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Dimensions of Morality in Islam together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

• Citizenship: active community life skills as learner discusses the purpose of morality.

• Learning to Learn: the skill of developing relationships as learners share knowledge on the purpose of morality during the

presentation.

• Creativity and Imagination: networking skills as learners dramatise acts depicting good morals.
